# Redocly

Covers Redocly projects built with Realm, Revel, Reef or Redoc.

## Detect

- Any of: `sidebars.yaml` or `<name>.sidebars.yaml`; `.md` pages with Markdoc tags (`{% admonition`, `{% tabs`, `{% partial`); `_partials/`, `@theme/` or `@l10n/` folders; `*.page.tsx`; `@redocly/realm`, `@redocly/revel`, `@redocly/reef` or `@redocly/redoc` in `package.json`. Projects built in Reunite may have no `package.json`.
- A `redocly.yaml` with only `extends`, `rules`, `decorators`, `preprocessors`, `plugins`, `apis`, `resolve` or `telemetry` is a Redocly CLI lint/bundle config, not a docs site. Leave it and migrate the framework that serves the docs.
- Legacy Developer Portal: `siteConfig.yaml`, `theme.ts`, `@redocly/developer-portal`, `.mdx` pages with `:::` admonitions. Navigation below applies; content is MDX, not Markdoc.
- Standalone Redoc embed (`redoc.standalone.js`, `<redoc spec-url>`, `redocly build-docs`): migrate only the OpenAPI file.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- File-based routing (https://redocly.com/docs/platform/content/project-structure): a file's path is its URL without the extension; `index.md` serves its folder. API description files render as references at their own path.
- Not published: partials folders (`_partials/`), `@theme/`, the root `README.md`, `ignore` globs. `static/` is copied as-is.
- Resolve `$ref` in `redocly.yaml` (for example `redirects: { $ref: ./redirects.yaml }`) and per-folder `redocly.yaml` files.

### From an export

Not covered yet. Use the repo or the live site.

### From the live site

Realm publishes `/llms.txt` with Markdown copies of pages unless `seo.llmstxt.hide` is set.

## Config → docs.json

| redocly.yaml                                                                                                                                                                                | docs.json                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `seo.title` / `seo.description`                                                                                                                                                             | `name` / `description`                                       |
| `seo.meta`, `seo.keywords`                                                                                                                                                                  | `seo.metatags`                                               |
| `logo.image` / `logo.srcSet` (`"l.svg light, d.svg dark"`) / `logo.link`                                                                                                                    | `logo` / `logo.light` + `logo.dark` / `logo.href`            |
| `logo.favicon`                                                                                                                                                                              | `favicon`                                                    |
| `navbar.items`                                                                                                                                                                              | Navigation below                                             |
| `footer.items` columns, `copyrightText`                                                                                                                                                     | `footer.links`, `footer.socials`; report copyright           |
| `redirects`                                                                                                                                                                                 | URLs below                                                   |
| `colorMode` with `ignoreDetection` and dark first                                                                                                                                           | `appearance` (`default: "dark"`, `strict: true`)             |
| `banner`                                                                                                                                                                                    | `banner` (first untargeted one)                              |
| `analytics.ga.trackingId`, `analytics.gtm.trackingId`                                                                                                                                       | `integrations.ga4.measurementId`, `integrations.gtm.tagId`   |
| `analytics.amplitude`, `segment`, `heap`, `adobe`                                                                                                                                           | the matching `integrations.*` entry                          |
| `scripts`, `links`                                                                                                                                                                          | `mint migrate --topic navigation`, Chrome                    |
| `markdown.lastUpdatedBlock`                                                                                                                                                                 | `metadata.timestamp`                                         |
| `products`                                                                                                                                                                                  | `navigation.products`                                        |
| `apis`, `decorators`                                                                                                                                                                        | keep in `redocly.yaml`; see Assets                           |
| `l10n`                                                                                                                                                                                      | `navigation.languages`, if the user migrates other languages |
| `seo.siteUrl`                                                                                                                                                                               | none; its host is part of every old URL                      |
| `access`, `rbac`, `requiresLogin`, `sso`, catalog and scorecard keys, `mockServer`, `aiAssistant`, `mcp`, `feedback`, `search`, `breadcrumbs`, `codeSnippet`, `*.hide`, `@theme/` overrides | drop and report; report every RBAC-protected path            |

Reference: https://redocly.com/docs/platform/config

## Navigation

Reference: https://redocly.com/docs/platform/navigation/sidebars

- No sidebar file: the file tree in natural sort order, `index` first.
- `sidebars.yaml` entries: `page` (+ `label`) → page; `group` + `items` → group (`page` → `root`; `expanded: true` or `always` → `expanded: true`); `directory` → that folder's pages in natural order; `href` → `navigation.global.anchors`; `$ref` → inline the referenced sidebar; `separator` → start a group named by its text; `separatorLine` → drop; `badges` → `tag`; `icon` → `icon`; `rbac`, `disconnect`, `additionalProps`, `external`, translation keys → drop.
- An API description listed as a `page` → a group with that spec's `openapi`.
- Top-level `tab:` entries (with `page`/`items` or `menu`) → tabs; a `menu` → tab `menu`. One `sidebars.yaml` per section folder, each linked from `navbar.items`, also means one tab per section.
- `navbar.items`: an item opening a section with its own sidebar → that section's tab; external `href` items → `navbar.links`; a sign-up button → `navbar.primary`.
- Sidebar labels default to the page's first heading.

## Content conversion

Every Markdoc tag must go (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags). Reference: https://redocly.com/docs/platform/content/markdoc-tags

| Markdoc                                                                                                                                                                  | Mintlify                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `{% admonition type="info\|warning\|success\|danger\|idea" name="T" %}`                                                                                                  | `<Info>`, `<Warning>`, `<Check>`, `<Danger>`, `<Tip>`; `name` per `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components |
| `{% tabs %}` / `{% tab label="X" %}`                                                                                                                                     | `<Tabs>` / `<Tab>`; `<CodeGroup>` when every tab is one fence                                                   |
| `{% code-group %}` (`mode="dropdown"`)                                                                                                                                   | `<CodeGroup>` (`dropdown`)                                                                                      |
| fence annotation ` ```js {% title="x" %} `                                                                                                                               | fence title; report other annotation keys                                                                       |
| `{% partial file="..." variables={...} /%}`; `{% $var %}` inside                                                                                                         | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content                                                             |
| `{% raw-partial file="..." /%}`                                                                                                                                          | the file's text inline                                                                                          |
| `{% code-snippet file="..." title="..." /%}` (with `from`/`to`/`before`/`after`)                                                                                         | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports                                                                 |
| `{% cards %}` / `{% card title to icon image %}`                                                                                                                         | `<Columns>` / `<Card title href icon img>`                                                                      |
| `{% accordion-group %}` / `{% accordion title expanded %}`                                                                                                               | `<AccordionGroup>` / `<Accordion defaultOpen>`                                                                  |
| `{% numbered-list %}` / `{% numbered-item %}`                                                                                                                            | `<Steps>` / `<Step>` (the item's first heading as title)                                                        |
| `{% img src alt caption /%}`                                                                                                                                             | image in `<Frame caption>`                                                                                      |
| `{% diagram type="mermaid" %}`                                                                                                                                           | `mermaid` fence; export PlantUML and Excalidraw to SVG and report                                               |
| `{% icon name /%}`                                                                                                                                                       | `<Icon>`                                                                                                        |
| `{% table %}`                                                                                                                                                            | Markdown table, or HTML for `colspan`/`rowspan`                                                                 |
| `{% if %}` / `{% else /%}`                                                                                                                                               | the branch the public site shows; report, especially `$rbac` / `$user` conditions                               |
| `{% $frontmatter.x %}`, `{% $env.X %}`                                                                                                                                   | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags                                                                |
| `{% json-schema %}`, `{% openapi-code-sample %}`, `{% openapi-response-sample %}`, `{% replay-openapi %}`                                                                | link to the endpoint page or a static example; report                                                           |
| `{% code-walkthrough %}`, `{% login-button %}`, `{% connect-mcp %}`, `{% markdoc-example %}`, `{% prompt %}`, custom tags in `@theme/markdoc/`                           | rewrite as prose or built-in components; report                                                                 |
| `## Heading {% #id %}` / `{% .class %}`                                                                                                                                  | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs / delete                                                         |
| frontmatter `excludeFromSearch: true`                                                                                                                                    | `searchable: false`                                                                                             |
| frontmatter `seo.description`                                                                                                                                            | `description`                                                                                                   |
| frontmatter `slug`, `redirects`                                                                                                                                          | URLs below                                                                                                      |
| frontmatter `sidebar`, `template`, `navigation`, `markdown`, `metadata`, `navbar`, `footer`, `breadcrumbs`, `codeSnippet`, `feedback`, `banner`, `rbac`, `versionPicker` | drop                                                                                                            |

## Assets

- Referenced images and files keep their paths; `static/` files keep their root paths.
- API decorators (`apis.<name>.decorators` or root `decorators`) change what readers see (`mint migrate --topic api`). `npx @redocly/cli bundle <api-name> --output <file>` writes a spec with them applied.
- Redoc vendor extensions: `x-codeSamples` carries over (`mint migrate --topic api`); `x-tagGroups`, `x-logo`, `x-traitTag`, `x-badges` do not (recreate tag grouping in navigation; report the rest).

## URLs and redirects

- Content pages keep their file paths. Frontmatter `slug` (string or list) overrides the path; extra slugs and frontmatter `redirects` become redirects.
- `redirects` (`'/from': { to: '/to', type: 301 }`) → a redirect each; `type` 302/307 → `permanent: false`; a trailing `/*` → `:slug*` on both sides (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- API references sit at the spec's file path with operation pages beneath it. Take old operation URLs from `sitemap.xml` and keep them per `mint migrate --topic api`.
- Hash links into Redoc (`#tag/...`, `#operation/...`): rewrite in-content links (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).

## Known gaps

- RBAC, login and SSO; role-based conditionals.
- Replay console, mock server, API catalog, scorecards.
- Code walkthroughs, custom Markdoc tags, `*.page.tsx` pages, theme overrides.
- Redoc vendor extensions without a Mintlify equivalent.
- `@l10n/` locales and `@<version>/` folders, unless the user migrates them.
- Heading anchors (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).
